config.label: path
config.description: path.delimiter-separated list of directories the per-call workingDirectory parameter may point at. Entries may be absolute or relative (resolved once against the server's launch cwd at startup). Defaults to '.' (authorizes only the launch directory).

config.label: Absolute path override for the JSON reporter output file
config.description: Absolute path override for the JSON reporter output file. Defaults to <workingDirectory>/test-results/results.json, computed per call.
